message: 力と知恵と
It seems Lolotte took Azel and headed out shopping.
And she was all excited about having a dinner party right after.
If Lolotte is by Azel's side, I can rest easy.
For now, I should let Melilot-san know how Azel looked today.

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, Synn-chan. What's the matter, at this hour?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, just a little something. I thought I'd let Melilot-san know how Azel is doing...」

name: Helena
message: 「I see... Knowing Melilot, didn't she bully Azel-chan with her blunt way of talking?」
Just as expected--I wonder if Helena-san is a psychic.

name: Synn
message: 「No... Even so, she was worried about Azel, and...」

name: Helena
message: 「And you came all this way for that... I'm sorry.」

name: Helena
message: 「Too bad, though. It seems Melilot is out for a little walk. Rare for her, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「A walk... you say?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes. While taking care of some work, you see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Work...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「So Soltia really did set up this magic circle to amplify the power of Re-Crea...」

name: Melilot
message: 「At this level, destroying it should be possible... However, what benefit could Soltia possibly gain from doing this?」

name: Melilot
message: 「She was fixated on the existence of angels. Does she believe Re-Crea has an effect of reincarnation...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「For now, I must stamp out even the smallest spark.」
Melilot touches the circle of magical power, invisible to the naked eye, to destroy its structure.
For Melilot, an expert in magic, it was supposed to be an easy task.
However--

name: Melilot
message: 「...I was repelled?!」
A different power, belonging to a system distinct from magic, acted upon hers and repulsed it.

name: Melilot
message: 「This is Spirit Power... So an angel and a Demon really did lend a hand to create this magic circle.」
One angel comes to mind. Yet right now, she can find no reason for that angel to make use of a magic circle.
Even so, a factor she cannot afford to overlook remains burned into the back of Melilot's mind.
「So you are of the Nive Clan... one who carries the blood of witches.」
「I'd heard rumors that a trueborn would be decent enough, but...」
「Will you be able to entertain me at least a little?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Bylous!」
The man called Bylous neither denies nor confirms that name, continuing to speak matter-of-factly.

name: Bylous
message: 「Has the Demon Lord not awakened yet?」

name: Melilot
message: 「How dare you ask that so shamelessly!!」
At the impudent question, Melilot bares her anger. Raising the tome that serves as her weapon, she takes a stance ready for battle.
Even so, Bylous remains completely unguarded as he continues speaking.
Facing the Demon who had defeated Soltia-one of the Seven Demon Generals who once ran rampant in the Human World-Bylous felt not the slightest hint of fear.

name: Bylous
message: 「A scholar of your caliber should be able to draw out even greater power from the Demon Lord.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If that is the case, shouldn't you take matters into your own hands?」

name: Bylous
message: 「That would reveal the limits of my vessel. Where's the fun in that?」
For Melilot, this was the first time exchanging words directly with Bylous.
It was unclear what intentions he had in trying to make use of this Re-Crea.
Even so, there was one thing she understood.
What he desired was strength. Not for himself, but strength bestowed upon others.
And the wish to confront that strength face-to-face.
It was not a wicked emotion tainted by lust for conquest, but something akin to interest and curiosity.
A gaze like that of a young boy admiring the strong.
Yet the will dwelling within those eyes seemed nothing short of sheer madness.
Leaving immense power unchecked breeds risk.
It strays from Melilot's established strategy, lowering the probability of success.

name: Bylous
message: 「You seem capable enough to enjoy a little warm-up. However, I will be the one to win.」
He had seen right through her. And before they had even crossed blades, she had already been branded the loser.

name: Bylous
message: 「Hasten the Demon Lord's awakening.」
An overly one-sided demand.
However, even without exchanging blows, Melilot understood all too well the extent of Bylous's power.
She knew he was not an opponent she could handle as an unforeseen variable.
Therefore, the right move here would be to comply obediently.
Turn his madness against him... Melilot, too, had a chance at victory, provided he let her walk away from here.
Biting her lip, even if her pride was wounded, Melilot presses forward to raise her odds of winning by even a fraction.
--Because that is my mission--

name: Melilot
message: 「...Understood.」
Bylous knew that the Nive Clan were not the sort to yield to force.
However, whether the answer was true or false was of utterly no consequence to Bylous.
